text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Opposition parties call for massive registration of voters on electoral lists.
- Organisation of Islamic Conference appoints former prime minister Azeddine Laraki as Secretary General.
- Shortage of milk ahead of fasting month of Ramadan due to poor distribution.
- Despite tighter control, immigration flow towards Europe via Spain continues.
- National commission in charge of follow-up of August social accord examines issues related to education and health staff.
- Marrakesh to host 8th ministerial meeting of French-speaking countries on Dec 17-18.
- Prime Minister Abdellatif Filali sends circular to ministers urging them to apply pay increases decided in August.
